cells.scene_caption: A continuous medium portrait shows a single adult woman with both arms initially raised in the original simple one-subject scene.

branch_descriptions.action: The main woman slowly lowers both raised arms, places both hands firmly on her hips, and holds that completed pose while the camera stays locked.
branch_descriptions.noop: The main woman keeps both arms raised for the entire shot, only breathing naturally, and never places either hand on her hips while the camera stays locked.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The main woman lowers both arms only halfway, pauses before reaching her hips, and finishes with both hands suspended away from the intended terminal pose.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The main woman begins with both hands on her hips, lifts both arms upward in reverse, and ends with both arms raised above the initial body line.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main woman first touches one hip, raises both arms again, lowers only one arm, and ends before both hands reach the registered final pose.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The background adult lowers both arms and places both hands on their hips, while the main woman remains still with both arms raised throughout.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The main woman keeps her arms raised and instead lifts and repositions a nearby handbag, leaving both hands away from her hips through the end.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The single main woman remains frozen in her initial pose while only the camera cranes sideways, tilts downward, and changes perspective without any arm action.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main woman's clothing gradually changes color while her raised-arm pose remains fixed, and neither hand moves toward either hip at any time.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The main woman turns once in place, takes two side steps, and returns to center without lowering both arms into the hands-on-hips pose.

branch_descriptions.noop: The main performer keeps the head angled away with a neutral closed mouth, only blinking and breathing, and never faces forward or forms the requested smile.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The main performer turns the head only partway toward the viewer but stops before a frontal pose and never completes the relaxed closed-mouth smile.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The main performer begins facing forward with a relaxed closed-mouth smile, loses the smile, turns the head away, and holds the averted neutral pose.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main performer smiles before turning, looks away again, briefly approaches a frontal angle, and ends without the ordered forward-facing smiling terminal state.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The background adult turns forward and gives a relaxed closed-mouth smile, while the main performer remains angled away with a neutral expression throughout.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The main performer keeps the head and mouth unchanged while adjusting a nearby scarf with both hands, never completing the requested facial and head transition.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The single main performer remains frozen while only the camera orbits toward a frontal viewpoint, creating an apparent angle change without any real head turn or smile.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main performer's hair color changes gradually while the head angle and neutral mouth remain fixed, with no forward turn and no new smile.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The main performer nods twice, looks downward, and raises the shoulders, but never turns fully forward or settles into the relaxed smiling expression.

cells.scene_caption: A continuous portrait shows a single adult performer holding a clear peace sign in the original simple one-subject scene.

branch_descriptions.noop: The main performer keeps the original two-finger peace sign unchanged, only breathing naturally, and never opens the whole palm or performs a wave.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The main performer relaxes the peace sign and opens the palm but stops before any side-to-side wave, ending with an unmoving open hand.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The main performer begins with an open waving palm, stops the wave, folds the fingers into a two-finger peace sign, and holds that reversed terminal gesture.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main performer waves while still holding the peace sign, briefly opens the palm, closes it again, and ends without the registered open-palm hold.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The background adult changes a peace sign into an open-palm wave, while the main performer keeps the original peace sign completely unchanged.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The main performer keeps the peace sign fixed and instead waves a small cloth held in the other hand, never producing the requested open-palm gesture.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The single main performer keeps both hands frozen while only the camera pans side to side, producing screen motion without any finger transition or hand wave.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main performer's sleeve changes color while the two-finger peace sign remains fixed, with no open palm and no side-to-side hand movement.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The main performer lowers the hand, claps twice, and folds both arms, never transforming the peace sign into the requested open-palm wave.

branch_descriptions.noop: The main performer keeps the left fist and original arm position unchanged throughout, only breathing naturally, and never extends an open palm forward.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The main performer opens the left fist and begins extending the arm but stops near the torso before reaching forward or rotating the palm downward.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The main performer begins with the left arm extended and palm-down, retracts the arm toward the torso, closes the hand into a fist, and holds it.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main performer extends a clenched fist, retracts it, briefly opens the hand, and ends near the torso without the ordered relaxed palm-down forward hold.

branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The main performer leaves the left fist unchanged and instead extends the right arm with its palm down, moving the wrong limb for the target action.

branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main performer's left sleeve changes texture while the clenched fist and arm position stay fixed, with no forward open-palm movement.

branch_descriptions.noop: The main French bulldog remains standing on all four legs, only breathing and making tiny natural movements, and never lowers into a seated position.
branch_descriptions.incomplete: The main French bulldog bends its hind legs and lowers partway but rises before its hips reach the ground, ending in a standing crouch.
branch_descriptions.reverse: The main French bulldog begins seated facing the camera, pushes upward through its legs, reaches a stable four-legged stand, and holds the standing pose.
branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main French bulldog lowers briefly, stands again, turns sideways, and crouches without completing and holding the ordered camera-facing seated terminal state.
branch_descriptions.wrong_actor: The background dog lowers into a stable sit facing the camera, while the main French bulldog remains standing on all four legs throughout.
branch_descriptions.wrong_object: The main French bulldog stays standing and pushes a nearby toy forward with one paw, moving the prop instead of lowering its own body to sit.
branch_descriptions.camera_only: The single main French bulldog remains frozen in its standing pose while only the camera lowers and moves forward, creating apparent vertical motion without the dog sitting.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main French bulldog's coat color changes gradually while its four-legged standing pose stays fixed, with no hind-leg bend or seated terminal state.
branch_descriptions.generic_wrong_motion: The main French bulldog walks in a small circle, shakes its head, and returns to standing without lowering its hips into a seated pose.

branch_descriptions.action: The main person shifts weight onto both feet, rises smoothly from kneeling, straightens both legs and the torso, and holds a stable upright standing pose.
branch_descriptions.noop: The main person remains kneeling in the original position, only breathing naturally, and never transfers weight to the feet or rises into a stand.

branch_descriptions.camera_only: The single main woman remains frozen while only the camera rises vertically and tilts downward, creating apparent upward motion without the kneeling woman standing.
branch_descriptions.appearance_only: The main person's clothing changes from dark to light while the kneeling body pose stays fixed, with no weight transfer or rise to standing.

branch_descriptions.shuffle: The main person turns toward the viewer before rising, drops back into the crouch, rises halfway again, and ends without the ordered straight standing hold.
